description: 🌍 Join our team for the NASA Space Apps Challenge! 🚀 Our mission is to become Earth Trend Detectives by exploring NASA data to discover patterns and understand changes happening on our planet. I'm interested in technology, problem-solving, and learning new things. I'm looking for teammates skilled or interested in programming, data analysis, science, research, web development, and design. Beginners are welcome! Let's collaborate, share ideas, and turn Earth data into meaningful discoveries!
